standard.summary: 仅对 Streaming Offload 生效。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Only takes effect for Streaming Offload.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 仅对 Streaming Offload 生效。把冷层分成 warm prefetch 与 cold on-demand，减少低端卡 PCIe 预取队列压力。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Only affects Streaming Offload. Splits cold layers into warm prefetch and cold on-demand, easing the PCIe prefetch-queue load on low-end cards. Off by default.
